summary: End-to-end testing of Quiz Realtime Platform: backend pipeline + WebSocket + frontend UI. 9/9 backend pytest tests pass (health, state, reset, logs, upload pipeline with real OpenAI gpt-5-mini + gpt-5, duplicate-stability, question switch, fragments, WS broadcast). All required frontend flows verified: waiting/success/error states, WS reactivity (no reload), diagnostic sheet, reset button, giant letter, question-number pill. No critical bugs found.

issues: Radix Dialog accessibility warning in console: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' — non-blocking but should be fixed by adding <SheetDescription /> or aria-describedby

transition-colors duration-150 on the root container animates the background change between waiting (white) and success (#050505). This means there is a brief (~150ms) intermediate gray flash. Not a bug per se, but if a clean instantaneous switch is desired remove 'transition-colors duration-150 ease-in-out' from the root div.

action_items: (Optional) Add SheetDescription/aria-describedby to /app/frontend/src/App.js DiagnosticPanel to silence Radix accessibility warning.
(Optional) Consider removing transition-colors on the root container if instantaneous color switch is preferred (current 150ms transition causes brief intermediate color).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~600 lines and concentrates OpenAI helpers, state, pipeline, and routes. Consider splitting into modules (state.py, openai_client.py, pipeline.py, routes.py) for maintainability.

process_extracted: when status had been 'error' (e.g., 'No se detectó número de pregunta' previously), a subsequent successful upload with valid qn correctly resets via state.reset(question_number=qn), good.
evaluate_options() iterates options sequentially — first match wins. If two options both match the answer (rare), iteration order is dict-insertion. Acceptable but worth noting.
WebSocket endpoint at /api/ws does not handle a backlog of dead connections beyond send failures; ConnectionManager.broadcast handles it correctly. OK.
MongoDB _id is correctly projected out in /api/logs ({'_id': 0}). Good.
ai_extract_from_image / ai_answer_question always return dicts with consistent shapes — no exception propagation. Good.
Frontend uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. WebSocket URL derived correctly via http→ws replacement. OK.
Frontend reconnect timer reschedules every 1.5s on close — fine, but no exponential backoff. Low priority.
test_credentials: N/A — platform is public, no auth.
seed_data_creation: No DB seed created. Used pre-existing /tmp/quiz1.jpg, /tmp/quiz2.jpg, /tmp/frag1.jpg, /tmp/frag2.jpg, /tmp/opts.jpg. MongoDB image_logs collection populated with real upload entries during tests (cleanup not required, logs are append-only history).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses REAL OpenAI calls (gpt-5-mini, gpt-5) — each upload consumes credits and takes ~10-30s. The pytest suite resets state before each test (fixture). WebSocket test is async and uses websockets library. If re-running, expect ~2 minutes total runtime. Frontend assertions on background color must wait ~300ms after the status changes due to a 150ms CSS transition on the root container.
